faq.question: What is the difference between the Software Systems degrees?
faq.answer: The college lists a three-year B.Sc. Software Systems and a separate five-year integrated M.Sc. Software Systems. The integrated route starts after Higher Secondary and has its own mathematics qualification; do not compare them as equal-duration postgraduate courses.

faq.question: Why is annual tuition on request?

faq.question: Can overseas qualifications be used?

faq.question: Does admission include hostel or employment?
faq.answer: Confirm residential allocation and costs separately with the college. A programme admission, industry-exposure component or published placement service does not guarantee a hostel room, internship or employment outcome.
